questions.question: Which day should a week start on?

options.label: Monday
options.adds: Weeks start on Monday, so Saturday and Sunday belong to the Monday-to-Sunday week they end.

options.label: Sunday
options.adds: Weeks start on Sunday, so Saturday belongs to the week that began the previous Sunday.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: Weekly grouping puts the weekend in the wrong week. Fix `week_key` so weekend days are grouped with the correct week. Change only `week_key`, and don't add tests or docs that weren't asked for. Done when the existing tests pass.
final: Weekly grouping puts the weekend in the wrong week. Fix `week_key` so weekend days are grouped with the correct week.
